description: A commotion breaks out in the market square as rough men in worn leather surround a merchant, their voices rising in threat. The shop owner, a middle-aged woman with worry etched into her face, pleads for more time as they demand immediate payment. Her goods—fine fabrics and rare trinkets—lie scattered, and you can see the desperation in her eyes. This could be your chance to gain favor with a merchant who might open new trade opportunities.

choices.option: Intervene with a charming worker to negotiate. (Requires Charm 70+; Potential: Reputation)
choices.message_success:
[acting_worker] steps forward with silver-tongued grace, their words cutting through the tension like a blade.

The debt collectors, disarmed by such persuasive charm, back down and agree to extended terms.

The merchant's eyes fill with gratitude as she grasps your hand. 'I owe you my livelihood,' she says. 'Come to my shop—I'll open the Adventurer's Market for you and your workers.' Word spreads quickly, and your reputation grows ({actual_reputation} reputation).
choices.message_failure: [acting_worker] tries to negotiate, but the debt collectors are too aggressive. They push past your worker and seize the merchant's goods. The opportunity slips away ({actual_reputation} reputation).

choices.option: Intervene with a combat-ready worker to intimidate. (Requires Combat 70+; Potential: Reputation)
choices.message_success:
[acting_worker] steps forward with intimidating presence, their hand resting on a weapon.

The debt collectors size one another up, and not one of them wants to be first to test your worker. Muttering about coming back with more men, they slink off empty-handed.

The merchant exhales shakily and grips your hand. 'I thought they'd break my arms this time,' she says. 'Come to my shop—I'll open the Adventurer's Market for you and your workers.' Talk of the standoff races through the square, and your reputation grows ({actual_reputation} reputation).
choices.message_failure: [acting_worker] squares up, but the debt collectors have muscle of their own and the numbers to back it. They shoulder past your worker and seize the merchant's goods. The opportunity slips away ({actual_reputation} reputation).

choices.option: Intervene with a clever worker to outmaneuver. (Requires Clever 70+; Potential: Reputation)
choices.message_success:
[acting_worker] steps forward with clever reasoning, exposing flaws in the debt collectors' claims and finding legal loopholes.

The collectors squint at the contract as clause after clause is turned against them. Unable to argue with the paperwork, they withdraw to 'consult their employer.'

The merchant stares at the voided terms, then at you. 'They had me signing my own ruin,' she says. 'Come to my shop—I'll open the Adventurer's Market for you and your workers.' The tale of the outwitted collectors makes the rounds, and your reputation grows ({actual_reputation} reputation).
choices.message_failure: [acting_worker] picks apart the contract's wording, but the collectors just laugh—they are paid to collect, not to read. They brush past your worker and seize the merchant's goods. The opportunity slips away ({actual_reputation} reputation).

choices.option: Pay the debt yourself to gain the merchant's favor. (Cost: Money; Gain: Reputation)
choices.message: You step forward and produce a heavy purse, covering the merchant's debt in full. The collectors' eyes widen at the coin, and they quickly disperse. The merchant thanks you profusely, promising to open her shop—the Adventurer's Market—to you and your workers. Your reputation for generosity spreads ({actual_money}, {actual_reputation} reputation).

choices.option: Stay out of it—this isn't your problem. (Neutral)
choices.message: You watch from the shadows as the debt collectors take what they came for. The merchant's shop remains closed, and you feel a missed opportunity slip away. Perhaps another chance will come.

The sum they keep repeating would ruin her — and would not dent your purse. Favor with a merchant like this could open new trade opportunities.

description: The merchant caught in the debt dispute spots you across the square. Her eyes light up with hope as she rushes over. 'Please—they've given me one more week to find a solution. I haven't forgotten your kindness, even if things didn't work out before. Will you help me this time? The Adventurer's Market could be yours if we succeed.'

description: A weary merchant with a cart of exotic goods approaches your establishment. 'I've traveled far and heard of your reputation,' she says. 'I run the Adventurer's Market—wares for those who've proven their worth. I'd like to extend you access. No strings attached. Consider it a gesture of goodwill to a fellow business owner.'

choices.option: Accept the merchant's offer. (Gain: Adventurer's Market access)
choices.message: You accept with gratitude. The merchant produces a writ bearing the Adventurer's Market seal. 'Present this at the entrance. You'll find quality goods at fair prices.' The Adventurer's Market is now available to you.

choices.option: Thank her, but pass for now. (No effect)
choices.message: You thank the merchant for the offer but explain that your current supply lines are serving you well enough. She takes it in stride—clearly not the first time she's heard this. 'The offer stands,' she says, tucking the writ back into her satchel. 'You know where to find me.' She wheels her cart onward down the street.

description: The merchant from the Adventurer's Market approaches you with a gleam in her eye. 'Your patronage has been a blessing,' she says, 'but I have grander visions. With an investment, I could expand my emporium into something truly magnificent—a place where only the finest goods are sold. Ten thousand coins would secure the location, permits, and the initial inventory. In return, you'll have exclusive access to the Elite Emporium, where treasures beyond the ordinary await.'

choices.option: Invest 10,000 coins to expand the emporium. (Cost: Money; Gain: Reputation)
choices.message: You count out the coins in stacks of ten across her counter, and the merchant watches each one land like a promise being kept. 'Within a week,' she says, hope steadying into certainty, 'the Elite Emporium will be ready. The finest goods, the rarest treasures—all available to you and yours.' Word of the investment spreads through the city, and merchants everywhere take notice ({actual_money}, {actual_reputation} reputation).

choices.option: Decline the investment for now. (Neutral)
choices.message: You explain that such an investment is beyond your current means. The merchant nods understandingly, though disappointment flickers in her eyes. 'Perhaps another time,' she says, 'when fortune favors us both.' The opportunity remains, but the Elite Emporium will have to wait.

description: The merchant returns, hope still burning in her eyes. 'I haven't given up on the Elite Emporium,' she says. 'The opportunity remains—ten thousand coins to open the most exclusive market in the city. Will you reconsider your investment?'

choices.option: Invest 10,000 coins to expand the emporium. (Cost: Money; Gain: Reputation)

choices.option: Still not ready to invest. (Neutral)
choices.message: You explain that you still need more time to gather the funds. The merchant accepts this with a nod, though her shoulders slump slightly. 'I'll be waiting,' she says, 'when you're ready to make this dream a reality.'
